symptom: Each idle Local command dropbox scanned every 100 milliseconds; removing its safety sweep could instead stall requests when an armed native watcher stayed silent.
rule: The bug-fix playbook requires fake-clock scheduler tests that bound idle work without removing recovery. Back off the safety sweep to two seconds, reset it to 100 milliseconds on activity, and prove a silent watcher still answers a request.
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/local-orchestration/__tests__/dropbox-idle.test.ts -t 'backs off to the safety interval while idle and still answers with a silent watcher'
